description:
Detect the selected checkout's layout once per invocation with one git process, inside the storage-owned git module, and hand that value to every consumer so none detects again.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One module under storage starts git, and layout detection is one probe process per invocation in the CLI and the server.
- [hard] REQ-02: Storage, the executor, init and hook installation use the supplied layout, and none of them starts git to detect it.
- [hard] REQ-03: A CLI test with a counting stand-in shows that `query available` and `issue show` start at most one git process in a primary and in a linked checkout.

## Notes

- Shared git test fixtures belong to this story.
title: Layout facts are detected once and reach every consumer
